limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
Pin-owned record disposal and whole-receipt map/peer disposal keep distinct original completion order; no generic cleanup proof is substituted.
Node setter preserves existing assignment behavior; it adds no new claim or validation and is used at original guarded points.
Shared namespace/revocation/backing contexts retain their existing active disposal and outer IRQ/guard/destructor qualification.
No physical completion/replay authority from metadata, retained backing, a missing leaf, empty prefix or error diagnostic.
No broader pressure/fairness, recovery custody, model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
